text.name: megaPatch_ibcDiesel_function
text.text: Mobile fuel supply on a pallet. Bring it to your farm and refuel machines parked next to it. Price follows the current diesel price.

text.name: megaPatch_fuel_priceUp
text.text: Fuel prices rising: diesel %s/l (+%s%%). IBC 1000 l: %s

text.name: megaPatch_fuel_priceDown
text.text: Fuel prices falling: diesel %s/l (-%s%%). IBC 1000 l: %s

text.name: megaPatch_finance_empty
text.text: No leased or financed vehicles. Lease a vehicle in the shop, then convert it to financing here.

text.name: megaPatch_finance_sectionLeased
text.text: Leased - can be financed (lease payments are credited)

text.name: megaPatch_finance_sectionFinanced
text.text: Financed - bank lien until paid off

text.name: megaPatch_finance_qRules
text.text: Missed payment = late fee and penalty interest. After %s missed payments in a row the bank repossesses the vehicle. Once paid off the vehicle is permanently yours.

text.name: megaPatch_finance_qBuyout
text.text: Lease almost paid - one-time buyout for: %s

text.name: megaPatch_finance_qNoMoney
text.text: Not enough money for down payment and fee.

text.name: megaPatch_finance_confirmArrears
text.text: Pay arrears of %s? Penalty interest will stop.

text.name: megaPatch_finance_confirmPayOff
text.text: Remaining balance %s + early repayment fee %s. Total: %s. Afterwards the vehicle is permanently yours.

text.name: megaPatch_finance_started
text.text: Contract signed: %s. Monthly payment %s. The vehicle now belongs to your farm.

text.name: megaPatch_finance_completed
text.text: Financing paid off: %s is now permanently yours!

text.name: megaPatch_finance_missed
text.text: Payment for %s missed! Arrears: %s. The bank repossesses the vehicle after %s more missed payments.

text.name: megaPatch_finance_repossessed
text.text: The bank repossessed %s for missed payments. Auction surplus refunded: %s

text.name: megaPatch_finance_soldSettled
text.text: Financed vehicle %s sold - the bank collected the remaining balance %s.

text.name: megaPatch_prod_empty
text.text: No factories available on this map.

text.name: megaPatch_prod_offer2
text.text: Or use it without buying - pay only for work done:

text.name: megaPatch_prod_offer3
text.text: Fee: %s%% of the market value of produced goods

text.name: megaPatch_prod_offer6
text.text: No fixed costs, no purchase price. After approx. %s years of typical use the fees exceed the purchase price.

text.name: megaPatch_prod_offer7
text.text: You can buy the factory later or end the contract in the menu (ESC) - Factories tab.

text.name: megaPatch_prod_confirmBuy
text.text: Buy the factory for %s? Fees paid so far (%s) are not credited.

text.name: megaPatch_prod_confirmEnd
text.text: End the contract? The factory returns to its owner and goods in its storage are lost.

text.name: megaPatch_prod_started
text.text: Using %s without buying. Fee %s%% of output value.

text.name: megaPatch_prod_cannotSell
text.text: You cannot sell this factory - you are using it without owning it.

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_bedText
text.text: Normal sleep until morning, or a long sleep of several months (max 1 year). Before a long sleep you get a forecast: what runs out, what will be ready to harvest, what will be wasted, plus probable earnings and losses.

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_hostOnly
text.text: Only a single player or the host can start a long sleep (time is shared).

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_notRecommended
text.text: NOT RECOMMENDED - you may lose a lot of money! Check the warnings below.

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_gainParts
text.text: Earnings: crops ready to harvest %s | cash (factory direct sales, income) %s | goods in factory storage %s

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_costParts
text.text: Costs: fixed and upkeep %s | leasing %s | financing payments %s | factory fees %s

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_balance
text.text: Balance now: %s Lowest balance during sleep: %s

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_aiActive
text.text: Stop all helpers (AI) first - they cannot work during a long sleep.

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_iFieldReady
text.text: Field %s: %s ready to harvest when you wake up (~%s)

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_wFieldRot
text.text: Field %s: %s will overripen and rot in month %s of the sleep - loss ~%s

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_wWeeds
text.text: Field %s: weeds - yield will be lower

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_wFood
text.text: %s: food runs out after %s days - animals lose health and production

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_wInput
text.text: %s: runs out of %s after %s months - production stops

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_wStorageFull
text.text: %s: storage for %s full after %s months - production stops

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_wDamaged
text.text: %s machines need repair (damage >=50%%). Parked machines do not wear in FS25.

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_wFinanceMoney
text.text: Not enough money for financing payments (%s payments) - the bank may repossess vehicles!

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_progress4
text.text: Game time is heavily accelerated - crops grow, animals and factories work, costs and payments are charged.

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_woke
text.text: Good morning! You slept %s game days. Balance change: %s

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_wokeEarly
text.text: You woke up early after %s game days. Balance change: %s

text.name: megaPatch_parking_function
text.text: Painted parking stripes for asphalt/concrete. Rotate and place side by side to build a parking lot.

text.name: megaPatch_paint_function
text.text: Road paint marking, follows the terrain. PgUp/PgDn = size (1-10 m). Rotate and place in construction mode.

text.name: megaPatch_sleep_wakeHint
text.text: To wake up early: go to the bed and press R

text.name: megaPatch_helper_etaLater
text.text: Travel time is calculated once the equipment is delivered.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_how
text.text: The contract is accepted with borrowed equipment. The helper attaches the tools, drives to the field and starts working right away at normal speed.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_wage
text.text: The helper is paid the normal hourly wage, as in the base game.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_noteHarvest
text.text: The combine stops when its tank is full - unloading and delivery are up to you.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_noteMaterial
text.text: Missing material is bought by the helper at the helper price (as in the base game).

text.name: megaPatch_helper_noteTakeOver
text.text: If you enter or move the equipment while the helper is on the way, the helper will not go.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_left
text.text: The helper is on the way to field %s (%s) - travel approx. %s.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_arrived
text.text: The helper arrived at field %s and is preparing the equipment.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_started
text.text: The helper is working on field %s.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_takenOver
text.text: You took over the equipment - the helper will not go to the contract.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_noVehicles
text.text: The contract was accepted without equipment - the helper has nothing to drive.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_noTractor
text.text: The contract equipment has no vehicle the helper could drive.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_waitLimit
text.text: All helpers are busy - this one starts as soon as one is free.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_aiFailed
text.text: The helper could not start working on field %s - check the equipment there.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_attachFailed
text.text: Some equipment could not be attached (%s) - it is still at the shop.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_startFailed
text.text: The contract could not be accepted.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_noPermission
text.text: You are not allowed to hire helpers.

text.name: megaPatch_helper_hudWaiting
text.text: Helper is waiting for the contract equipment...
